name: designloop
description: DesignLoop: practise Low-Level Design, submit a structured design, and get rubric-based, evidence-linked feedback.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: npm run build -w web && npm run start -w server
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
